assets.prompt: Edit the attached transparent pixel-art artwork for Đại Lực Kim Cương Chưởng, keeping its recognizable bald saffron Shaolin monk and the upright, open, golden five-finger palm projectile with clearly drawn fingers and palm creases. Make a wide two-row transparent artwork comparison. Put the same little monk thrusting his palm on the far left of each row. There are precisely FOUR hands made of qi across the entire board. TOP ROW = ordinary cast, exactly three SMALL gold palm projectiles on three separated parallel horizontal tracks moving RIGHT. They were released in order TOP, MIDDLE, BOTTOM, so the top projectile has traveled furthest, the middle one is partway, the bottom one has just launched and is nearest the monk. Show a strong visual staircase: center of top palm at approximately 83% of image width, center of middle palm at 64%, center of bottom palm at 45%; each next palm is both lower and distinctly further left, with the three bodies widely separated, no overlap. Draw three separate thin HORIZONTAL gold trails each going LEFT from its palm; never connect the lanes with a diagonal trail. Leave room for these three tracks within the top half. BOTTOM ROW = Phát Động, exactly ONE huge open golden palm projectile on the single center track shooting straight RIGHT, roughly 2.5 to 3 times the height of an ordinary palm, with substantial yet crisp gold contours and a short concentrated amber pressure trail. No small satellite projectiles around the big palm. Show no separate impact or extra hand silhouettes. Preserve elevated right-facing orthographic RPG pixel style and saffron/bronze palette. Give both rows wide clean alpha gutters, no background, no text, no border, no charts, no haze or checkerboard. Keep the staircase unmistakable at small size.

Edit the attached transparent Vô Ảnh Cước 2×2 pixel-art board. Preserve the upper-left grounded caster, the bottom-left clean flying-kick pose and the bottom-right player's airborne body geometry from the reference. Same youthful bald Shaolin monk with saffron robe, one foot extended toward screen-right, rear knee tightly folded underneath, same chibi proportions and camera. Make only two changes. (1) Upper-right NORMAL mode: keep exactly three small recognizable golden foot-sole projectiles, one per upper, middle and lower horizontal lane. Reposition them into an unmistakable staircase climbing up toward the right. The TOP foot was launched first and is farthest right, around 91% image width; the MIDDLE foot is second, around 77%; the BOTTOM foot is last and farthest left, around 63%. Separate their silhouettes and keep each individual gold motion trail HORIZONTAL pointing left. No vertical stack, diagonal trajectories or fourth foot. (2) Bottom-right EMPOWERED mode: preserve the air-dashing player, the yellow heel crescent, the afterimage and short rightward travel from the reference. Add a second lower layer of ground-skimming WIND AND DUST below the airborne player and extending left behind his dash, visibly separate from the elevated gold afterimage. Render thin pale ivory-gray flattened wind ribbons curling along the invisible floor plane, with sandy tan swept-back dust puffs, a few tiny earth crumbs and dissipating grains. The lower wind hugs the ground and never covers the boots or body. No ground slab, no environment or explosion crater. Keep the dust desaturated against the golden heel flash and keep the authentic pixel finish and transparent canvas. No lettering, panels or backdrop.
